title: Adi-khanda, part 14 (portion 22)
html:
The second wedding (conclusion): the adhivasa of the Lord and of Vishnupriya; the wedding morning; the bridegroom's attire and the bride's beauty; the wedding procession and the excitement of the women of Nadia; the welcoming of the bridegroom, the exchange of glances and the giving away of the bride in Sanatana's house; the wedding night, the kushandika, Sanatana's farewell; Shachi welcomes the couple home

Raga ramakeli; disha: "Hari, Rama, Narayana — Shachi's darling, golden Gora!"

তবে ত পণ্ডিত অতি হরষিত মনে ।
আনন্দে করয়ে শুভদিন শুভক্ষণে ॥ ৭৯ ॥

tabe ta paṇḍita ati haraṣita mane |
ānande karaẏe śubhadina śubhakṣaṇe || 79 ||

tabe ta — then; pandita — the pandit; ati harashita mane — with great joy in his heart; anande — happily; karaye — fixes; shubha-dina shubha-kshane — an auspicious day and an auspicious moment

79Then the pandit, with great joy in his heart,
happily fixes an auspicious day and an auspicious moment.

এথা প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর এছন জানিঞা ।
শুভদিন করে ঘরে গণক আনিঞা ॥ ৮০ ॥

ethā prabhu biśbambhara echana jāniñā |
śubhadina kare ghare gaṇaka āniñā || 80 ||

etha — here; prabhu vishvambhara — the Lord Vishvambhara; echhana janina — learning of this; shubha-dina kare — fixes the auspicious day; ghare — at home; ganaka anina — calling an astrologer

80And here the Lord Vishvambhara, learning of it,
called an astrologer to His house and fixes the auspicious day.

চর্চিয়া করিল দিন সময় বিচিত্র ।
শুভকাল শুভলগ্ন তিথি সুনক্ষত্র ॥ ৮১ ॥

carciẏā karila dina samaẏa bicitra |
śubhakāla śubhalagna tithi sunakṣatra || 81 ||

charchiya — after deliberation; karila dina — they fixed the day; samaya vichitra — a wonderful time; shubha-kala — auspicious hour; shubha-lagna — auspicious lagna; tithi — lunar day; su-nakshatra — favourable nakshatra

81After deliberation they fixed the day, a wonderful time:
an auspicious hour, an auspicious lagna, tithi and a favourable nakshatra1.

অধিবাস-কালে সাধু ব্রাহ্মণ সজ্জন ।
মিলিয়া করিল প্রভুর শুভ প্রয়োজন ॥ ৮২ ॥

adhibāsa-kāle sādhu brāhmaṇa sajjana |
miliẏā karila prabhura śubha praẏojana || 82 ||

adhivasa-kale — at the time of the adhivasa; sadhu — holy men; brahmana — brahmanas; sajjana — good people; miliya — gathering; karila — arranged; prabhura — for the Lord; shubha prayojana — what the auspicious rite required

82At the time of the adhivasa, holy men, brahmanas and good people
gathered and arranged for the Lord all that the auspicious rite required.

আনন্দিত শচীদেবী আইহ-সুহ লঞা ।
পুত্র-মহোৎসব করে নানা দ্রব্য দিয়া ॥ ৮৩ ॥

ānandita śacīdebī āiha-suha lañā |
putra-mahotsaba kare nānā drabya diẏā || 83 ||

anandita shachidevi — joyful Shachi-devi; aiha-suha lana — gathering the married women; putra-mahotsava kare — celebrates her son's festival; nana dravya diya — giving all kinds of gifts

83Joyful Shachi-devi, gathering the married women,
celebrates her son's festival, giving all kinds of gifts:

তৈল হরিদ্রা আর ললাটে সিন্দুর ।
খদি কদলক আর সন্দেশ তাম্বূল ॥ ৮৪ ॥

taila haridrā āra lalāṭe sindura |
khadi kadalaka āra sandeśa tāmbūla || 84 ||

taila — oil; haridra — turmeric; ara — and; lalate sindura — sindura on the forehead; khadi — puffed rice; kadalaka — bananas; sandesha — sweets; tambula — betel

84oil, turmeric and sindura for the forehead,
puffed rice, bananas, sweets and betel.

আনন্দে মঙ্গল গায় যত আইহগণ ।
প্রভু-অধিবাস করে যতেক ব্রাহ্মণ ॥ ৮৫ ॥

ānande maṅgala gāẏa yata āihagaṇa |
prabhu-adhibāsa kare yateka brāhmaṇa || 85 ||

anande — joyfully; mangala gaya — sing auspicious songs; yata aiha-gana — all the married women; prabhu-adhivasa kare — perform the Lord's adhivasa; yateka brahmana — all the brahmanas

85Joyfully all the married women sing auspicious songs;
all the brahmanas perform the Lord's adhivasa.

ধূপ দীপ পতাকা শোভিত দিগন্তরে ।
স্বস্তিবাচন-পূর্ব দেবপূজা করে ॥ ৮৬ ॥

dhūpa dīpa patākā śobhita digantare |
sbastibācana-pūrba debapūjā kare || 86 ||

dhupa — incense; dipa — lamps; pataka — banners; shobhita digantare — the quarters are adorned; svastivachana-purva — after the svastivachana blessings; deva-puja kare — they worship the gods

86All the quarters are adorned with incense, lamps and banners;
after the svastivachana blessings they worship the gods.

ব্রাহ্মণেতে বেদ পড়ে বাজে শুভশঙ্খ ।
নানাবিধ বাদ্য বাজে পটহ মৃদঙ্গ ॥ ৮৭ ॥

brāhmaṇete beda paṛe bāje śubhaśaṅkha |
nānābidha bādya bāje paṭaha mṛdaṅga || 87 ||

brahmanete veda pade — the brahmanas recite the Vedas; baje shubha-shankha — auspicious conches sound; nanavidha vadya baje — all kinds of instruments play; pataha mridanga — patahas and mridangas

87The brahmanas recite the Vedas, auspicious conches sound,
all kinds of instruments play — pataha drums and mridangas.

চৌদিকেতে কুলবধূ দেই জয় জয় ।
প্রভু-অধিবাস হৈল উত্তম সময় ॥ ৮৮ ॥

caudikete kulabadhū dei jaẏa jaẏa |
prabhu-adhibāsa haila uttama samaẏa || 88 ||

chaudikete — on all sides; kulavadhu — wives of noble families; dei jaya jaya — cry "Jaya, jaya!"; prabhu-adhivasa haila — the Lord's adhivasa took place; uttama samaya — at an excellent hour

88On all sides the wives of noble families cry "Jaya, jaya!";
the Lord's adhivasa fell at an excellent hour.

গন্ধ-চন্দন-মাল্যে পূজিল ব্রাহ্মণ ।
কর্পূর তাম্বূল আর ভূরি বিভূষণ ॥ ৮৯ ॥

gandha-candana-mālye pūjila brāhmaṇa |
karpūra tāmbūla āra bhūri bibhūṣaṇa || 89 ||

gandha-chandana-malye — with scents, sandal and garlands; pujila brahmana — the brahmanas were honoured; karpura — camphor; tambula — betel; ara — and; bhuri vibhushana — many ornaments

89The brahmanas were honoured with scents, sandal and garlands,
with camphor, betel and many ornaments.

হেনকালে পণ্ডিত শ্রীযুত সনাতন ।
অতিশ্রদ্ধাযুত সেই উলসিত-মন ॥ ৯০ ॥

henakāle paṇḍita śrīyuta sanātana |
atiśraddhāyuta sei ulasita-mana || 90 ||

henakale — at this time; pandita shriyuta sanatana — the venerable pandit Sanatana; ati-shraddha-yuta — full of reverence; sei ulasita-mana — his heart rejoicing

90At this time the venerable pandit Sanatana,
full of reverence, his heart rejoicing,

ব্রাহ্মণ পাঠাইল আর বিপ্রসাধ্বীগণ ।
জামাতার অধিবাস করিবার মন ॥ ৯১ ॥

brāhmaṇa pāṭhāila āra biprasādhbīgaṇa |
jāmātāra adhibāsa karibāra mana || 91 ||

brahmana pathaila — sent brahmanas; ara vipra-sadhvi-gana — and virtuous brahmana wives; jamatara adhivasa — the son-in-law's adhivasa; karibara mana — wishing to perform

91sent brahmanas and virtuous brahmana wives,
wishing to perform the adhivasa of his son-in-law,

আপনে আপন-কন্যা-অধিবাস করে ।
ঝলমল করে অঙ্গ রত্ন-অলঙ্কারে ॥ ৯২ ॥

āpane āpana-kanyā-adhibāsa kare |
jhalamala kare aṅga ratna-alaṅkāre || 92 ||

apane — himself; apana-kanya-adhivasa kare — performs the adhivasa of his own daughter; jhalamala kare anga — [her] body glitters; ratna-alankare — with jewelled ornaments

92while he himself performs the adhivasa of his daughter;
her body glitters with jewelled ornaments.

দেবপূজা পিতৃপূজা করে যথাবিধি ।
অধিবাস-কালে জয় জয় নিরবধি ॥ ৯৩ ॥

debapūjā pitṛpūjā kare yathābidhi |
adhibāsa-kāle jaẏa jaẏa nirabadhi || 93 ||

deva-puja — worship of the gods; pitri-puja — worship of the ancestors; kare yathavidhi — performs duly; adhivasa-kale — during the adhivasa; jaya jaya — "Jaya, jaya!"; niravadhi — without cease

93He duly performs the worship of the gods and the ancestors;
throughout the adhivasa "Jaya, jaya!" resounds without cease.

ব্রাহ্মণেতে বেদ পড়ে বাজে শুভশঙ্খ ।
আনন্দে দুন্দুভি বাজে বাজয়ে মৃদঙ্গ ॥ ৯৪ ॥

brāhmaṇete beda paṛe bāje śubhaśaṅkha |
ānande dundubhi bāje bājaẏe mṛdaṅga || 94 ||

brahmanete veda pade — the brahmanas recite the Vedas; baje shubha-shankha — auspicious conches sound; anande dundubhi baje — dundubhis joyfully resound; bajaye mridanga — mridangas play

94The brahmanas recite the Vedas, auspicious conches sound,
dundubhis joyfully resound, mridangas play.

হেনমতে দুইজনের অধিবাস হৈল ।
তার-পর-দিনে প্রভু প্রভাতে উঠিল ॥ ৯৫ ॥

henamate duijanera adhibāsa haila |
tāra-para-dine prabhu prabhāte uṭhila || 95 ||

henamate — thus; duijanera adhivasa haila — the adhivasa of the two took place; tara-para-dine — on the next day; prabhu prabhate uthila — the Lord rose at dawn

95Thus the adhivasa of the two was performed;
on the next day the Lord rose at dawn2.

নানাবিধ বাদ্য বাজে জয় হুলাহুলি ।
রস-ভরে রমণী চলিলা ঢুলি ঢুলি ॥ ৯৫+১ ॥

nānābidha bādya bāje jaẏa hulāhuli |
rasa-bhare ramaṇī calilā ḍhuli ḍhuli || 95+1 ||

nanavidha badya baje — all kinds of instruments sound; jaya hulahuli — cries of "Jaya!" and "ulu-ulu"; rasa-bhare — full of rasa; ramani chalila — the women went; dhuli dhuli — swaying

95+1All kinds of instruments sound, cries of "Jaya!" and "ulu-ulu";
full of rasa, the women went along, swaying3.

রসের আবেশে মনে কত উঠে ভাব ।
গৌরাঙ্গ-মাধুর্য-রস হৃদয়ের লাভ ॥ ৯৫+২ ॥

rasera ābeśe mane kata uṭhe bhāba |
gaurāṅga-mādhurya-rasa hṛdaẏera lābha || 95+2 ||

rasera aveshe — rapt in rasa; mane — in the heart; kata uthe bhava — how many feelings rise; gauranga-madhurya-rasa — the sweet rasa of Gauranga; hridayera labha — the heart's gain

95+2Rapt in rasa, how many feelings rise in their hearts!
The sweetness of Gauranga is what their hearts have gained.

সুচন্দ্রিম রজনীতে সুমঙ্গল গীত ।
বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া-বিবাহে সে করিল বিহিত ॥ ৯৫+৩ ॥

sucandrima rajanīte sumaṅgala gīta |
biṣṇupriẏā-bibāhe se karila bihita || 95+3 ||

suchandrima rajanite — on the moonlit night; sumangala gita — auspicious songs; vishnupriya-vivahe — for Vishnupriya's wedding; se karila vihita — they did what is prescribed

95+3On the moonlit night [rang] auspicious songs;
all that is proper for Vishnupriya's wedding they performed.

এইমতে জলসাহি কুলবধূগণ ।
প্রভাত-সময়ে আইল শচীর ভবন ॥ ৯৫+৪ ॥

eimate jalasāhi kulabadhūgaṇa |
prabhāta-samaẏe āila śacīra bhabana || 95+4 ||

eimate — thus; jalasahi — having fetched the water; kulabadhu-gana — the wives of noble families; prabhata-samaye — at dawn; aila shachira bhavana — came to Shachi's house

95+4Thus, having fetched the water, the wives of noble families
came at dawn to Shachi's house.

প্রাতঃক্রিয়া করি প্রভু কৈল গঙ্গাস্নান ।
নান্দীমুখ-শ্রাদ্ধ কৈল যে ছিল বিধান ॥ ৯৬ ॥

prātaḥkriẏā kari prabhu kaila gaṅgāsnāna |
nāndīmukha-śrāddha kaila ye chila bidhāna || 96 ||

pratah-kriya kari — after His morning rites; prabhu kaila ganga-snana — the Lord bathed in the Ganga; nandimukha-shraddha kaila — performed the nandimukha-shraddha; ye chhila vidhana — as was prescribed

96After His morning rites the Lord bathed in the Ganga
and performed the nandimukha-shraddha as prescribed.

দেবপূজা পিতৃপূজা করি সমাধান ।
বিবাহ-উচিত প্রভু করে পুনঃ স্নান ॥ ৯৭ ॥

debapūjā pitṛpūjā kari samādhāna |
bibāha-ucita prabhu kare punaḥ snāna || 97 ||

deva-puja pitri-puja — worship of gods and ancestors; kari samadhana — having completed; vivaha-uchita — as befits a wedding; prabhu kare punah snana — the Lord bathes again

97Having completed the worship of the gods and the ancestors,
the Lord bathes again, as is proper before a wedding.

নাপিতে নাপিত-ক্রিয়া করিল তখন ।
অঙ্গ-উদ্বর্তন করে কুলবধূগণ ॥ ৯৮ ॥

nāpite nāpita-kriẏā karila takhana |
aṅga-udbartana kare kulabadhūgaṇa || 98 ||

napite — the barber; napita-kriya karila — did the barber's work; takhana — then; anga-udvartana kare — anoint the body; kulavadhu-gana — the wives of noble families

98Then the barber did his work,
and the wives of noble families anoint His body.

গন্ধ-আমলকী দেই তৈল হরিদ্রা ।
শ্রীঅঙ্গ-পরশে কেহো সুখে গেল নিদ্রা ॥ ৯৮+১ ॥

gandha-āmalakī dei taila haridrā |
śrīaṅga-paraśe keho sukhe gela nidrā || 98+1 ||

gandha-amalaki dei — apply fragrant amalaki; taila haridra — oil, turmeric; sri-anga-parashe — touching the divine body; keho — one; sukhe gela nidra — swooned in bliss (lit. "fell asleep")

98+1They apply fragrant amalaki, oil and turmeric;
one, touching His divine body, sank into a swoon of bliss4.

কেহো পাদ-সম্বাহন করে হরষিতা ।
বেকত বদন কেহো লজ্জা রহে কোথা ॥ ৯৮+২ ॥

keho pāda-sambāhana kare haraṣitā |
bekata badana keho lajjā rahe kothā || 98+2 ||

keho — another; pada-samvahana kare — massages the feet; harashita — joyfully; vekata badana keho — one with uncovered face; lajja rahe kotha — where is shame

98+2Another joyfully massages His feet;
another's face is uncovered — where has shame gone?

নয়নে গলয়ে কারো হরষের নীর ।
অঙ্গের বাতাসে কারো কাঁপয়ে শরীর ॥ ৯৮+৩ ॥

naẏane galaẏe kāro haraṣera nīra |
aṅgera bātāse kāro kāṁpaẏe śarīra || 98+3 ||

nayane galaye karo — from the eyes of some flow; harashera nira — tears of joy; angera batase — at the breeze of [His] body; karo kapaye sharira — the bodies of others tremble

98+3From the eyes of some flow tears of joy,
the bodies of others tremble at the breeze from His body.

উনমত নারীগণ করে অভিষেক ।
পূরুবের মনঃকথা করয়ে পরতেক ॥ ৯৮+৪ ॥

unamata nārīgaṇa kare abhiṣeka |
pūrubera manaḥkathā karaẏe parateka || 98+4 ||

unamata nari-gana — the frenzied women; kare abhisheka — perform the bathing; puruvera manahkatha — the long-cherished wish of the heart; karaye parateka — make manifest

98+4The frenzied women bathe [the Lord],
openly showing the long-cherished wish of their hearts.

অঙ্গ হেলি পড়ে কেহো গঙ্গাজল ঢালে ।
জয় হুলাহুলি শুনি সুমঙ্গল রোলে ॥ ৯৮+৫ ॥

aṅga heli paṛe keho gaṅgājala ḍhāle |
jaẏa hulāhuli śuni sumaṅgala role || 98+5 ||

anga heli pade keho — one, leaning, sinks; gangajala dhale — [another] pours Ganga water; jaya hulahuli shuni — "Jaya!" and "ulu-ulu" are heard; sumangala role — with auspicious shouts

98+5One, leaning, sinks [against Him], another pours Ganga water;
cries of "Jaya!" and "ulu-ulu" are heard with auspicious shouts.

নদিয়া নগরে ভেল আনন্দ উৎসাহ ।
সর্ব-সুমঙ্গল বিশ্বম্ভরের বিবাহ ॥ ৯৯ ॥

nadiẏā nagare bhela ānanda utsāha |
sarba-sumaṅgala biśbambharera bibāha || 99 ||

nadiya nagare — in the town of Nadia; bhela — there arose; ananda utsaha — joy and jubilation; sarva-sumangala — all-auspicious; vishvambharera vivaha — Vishvambhara's wedding

99In the town of Nadia there is joy and jubilation:
Vishvambhara's wedding is an all-auspicious festival.

তবে সেই মহাপ্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর রায় ।
অঙ্গের সুবেশ করে যতেক জুয়ায় ॥ ১০০ ॥

tabe sei mahāprabhu biśbambhara rāẏa |
aṅgera subeśa kare yateka juẏāẏa || 100 ||

tabe — then; sei mahaprabhu vishvambhara raya — Mahaprabhu Vishvambhara Raya; angera suvesha kare — adorns His body; yateka juyaya — with all that is fitting

100Then Mahaprabhu Vishvambhara Raya
adorns His body with all that is fitting:

দিব্য রত্ন-অলঙ্কার রক্তপ্রান্ত-বাস ।
মহ-মহ করে গোরা-অঙ্গের বাতাস ॥ ১০১ ॥

dibya ratna-alaṅkāra raktaprānta-bāsa |
maha-maha kare gorā-aṅgera bātāsa || 101 ||

divya ratna-alankara — divine jewelled ornaments; rakta-pranta-vasa — a cloth with a red border; maha-maha kare — is fragrant; gora-angera batasa — the breeze from Gora's body

101divine jewelled ornaments, a cloth with a red border;
the breeze from Gora's body spreads fragrance.

সহজে শ্রীঅঙ্গ-গন্ধ আরে দিব্য-গন্ধ ।
চন্দন-তিলক ভালে শ্রীমুখচন্দ্র ॥ ১০২ ॥

sahaje śrīaṅga-gandha āre dibya-gandha |
candana-tilaka bhāle śrīmukhacandra || 102 ||

sahaje — natural; shri-anga-gandha — the fragrance of the divine body; are divya-gandha — and divine perfumes besides; chandana-tilaka bhale — sandal tilaka on the forehead; shri-mukha-chandra — the beautiful moon-like face

102The natural fragrance of His divine body — and divine perfumes besides;
a sandal tilaka on the forehead, and the beautiful moon-like face.

নখচন্দ্র শোভা করে অঙ্গুলে অঙ্গুরী ।
ঝলমল অঙ্গতেজ চাহিতে না পারি ॥ ১০৩ ॥

nakhacandra śobhā kare aṅgule aṅgurī |
jhalamala aṅgateja cāhite nā pāri || 103 ||

nakha-chandra shobha kare — the moon-like nails shine; angule anguri — rings on the fingers; jhalamala anga-teja — the radiance of the body dazzles; chahite na pari — one cannot look

103The nails shine like moons, rings are on the fingers;
the radiance of His body dazzles — one cannot look at it.

অতি সুকোমল রাঙা অধর-বিম্বক ।
শ্রবণে শোভয়ে গণ্ড কুসুম-বন্ধুক ॥ ১০৪ ॥

ati sukomala rāṅā adhara-bimbaka |
śrabaṇe śobhaẏe gaṇḍa kusuma-bandhuka || 104 ||

ati sukomala — very soft; ranga adhara-bimbaka — red lips like bimba fruits; shravane — by the ears; shobhaye ganda — the cheeks shine; kusuma-bandhuka — [like] bandhuka flowers

104The soft red lips are like bimba fruits;
by the ears the cheeks shine like bandhuka flowers.

অঙ্গদ কঙ্কণ করে চরণে নূপুর ।
দেখিয়া নাগরী-হিয়া করে দুরদুর ॥ ১০৫ ॥

aṅgada kaṅkaṇa kare caraṇe nūpura |
dekhiẏā nāgarī-hiẏā kare duradura || 105 ||

angada kankana kare — armlets and bracelets on the arms; charane nupura — anklets on the feet; dekhiya — seeing [Him]; nagari-hiya kare duradura — the nagaris' hearts tremble

105Armlets and bracelets on the arms, anklets on the feet;
seeing Him, the nagaris tremble at heart5.

বেঢ়িলা গৌরাঙ্গ যত নাগরীর গণ ।
শশধর বেঢ়ি যেন তারার শোভন ॥ ১০৫+১ ॥

beṛhilā gaurāṅga yata nāgarīra gaṇa |
śaśadhara beṛhi yena tārāra śobhana || 105+1 ||

bedhila gauranga — surrounded Gauranga; yata nagarira gana — all the nagaris; shashadhara bedhi — encircling the moon; yena tarara shobhana — like the beauty of the stars

105+1All the nagaris surrounded Gauranga —
as the stars in their beauty encircle the moon6.

মদন-মদেতে মত্ত হৈলা সব নারী ।
লজ্জা ভয় তেজিয়া রহিলা মুখ হেরি ॥ ১০৫+২ ॥

madana-madete matta hailā saba nārī |
lajjā bhaẏa tejiẏā rahilā mukha heri || 105+2 ||

madana-madete — with the wine of Madana; matta haila saba nari — all the women grew drunk; lajja bhaya tejiya — casting off shame and fear; rahila mukha heri — stood gazing at the face

105+2All the women grew drunk with the wine of Madana;
casting off shame and fear, they stood gazing at His face.

পণ্ডিত শ্রীসনাতন এথা নিজ ঘরে ।
নিজ কন্যা ভূষা করে রত্ন-অলঙ্কারে ॥ ১০৬ ॥

paṇḍita śrīsanātana ethā nija ghare |
nija kanyā bhūṣā kare ratna-alaṅkāre || 106 ||

pandita shri-sanatana — the pandit Sri Sanatana; etha nija ghare — here in his own house; nija kanya bhusha kare — adorns his daughter; ratna-alankare — with jewelled ornaments

106And here, in his own house, the pandit Sri Sanatana
adorns his daughter with jewelled ornaments.

গন্ধ চন্দন মাল্যে করাইল বেশ ।
বিনি বেশে অঙ্গছটায় আলো কৈল দেশ ॥ ১০৭ ॥

gandha candana mālye karāila beśa |
bini beśe aṅgachaṭāẏa ālo kaila deśa || 107 ||

gandha chandana malye — with scents, sandal and garlands; karaila vesha — they arrayed her; vini veshe — even without adornment; anga-chhataya — by the radiance of her body; alo kaila desha — lit up the land

107She was arrayed with scents, sandal and garlands;
yet even without adornment the radiance of her body lit up the land.

বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়ার অঙ্গ জিনি লাখবাণ সোণা ।
ঝলমল করে যেন তড়িত-প্রতিমা ॥ ১০৮ ॥

biṣṇupriẏāra aṅga jini lākhabāṇa soṇā |
jhalamala kare yena taṛita-pratimā || 108 ||

vishnupriyara anga — Vishnupriya's body; jini — surpasses; lakhabana sona — the purest gold (lit. "refined a hundred thousand times"); jhalamala kare — glitters; yena tadita-pratima — like lightning that has taken form

108Vishnupriya's body surpasses the purest gold;
she glitters like lightning that has taken form.

ফণিধর জিনি বেণী মুনিমন মোহে ।
কপালে সিন্দুর সে তুলনা দিব কে ॥ ১০৯ ॥

phaṇidhara jini beṇī munimana mohe |
kapāle sindura se tulanā diba ke || 109 ||

phanidhara jini — surpassing a serpent; veni — the braid; muni-mana mohe — captivates the minds of sages; kapale sindura — the sindura on the forehead; se tulana diba ke — who could find a comparison for it

109Her braid surpasses a serpent and captivates the minds of sages;
the sindura on her forehead — to what can it be compared?

ভুরুভঙ্গ অনঙ্গ-সারঙ্গ মনোহর ।
শুক-ওষ্ঠ জিনি নাসা পরম সুন্দর ॥ ১১০ ॥

bhurubhaṅga anaṅga-sāraṅga manohara |
śuka-oṣṭha jini nāsā parama sundara || 110 ||

bhuru-bhanga — the curve of the brows; ananga-saranga — [like] Ananga's bow; manohara — lovely; shuka-oshtha jini — surpassing a parrot's beak; nasa — the nose; parama sundara — supremely beautiful

110The curve of her brows is lovely as Ananga's bow;
her nose surpasses a parrot's beak — it is supremely beautiful.

কুরঙ্গনয়ন জিনি নয়নযুগল ।
গৃধিনীর কর্ণ জিনি কর্ণ মনোহর ॥ ১১১ ॥

kuraṅganaẏana jini naẏanayugala |
gṛdhinīra karṇa jini karṇa manohara || 111 ||

kuranga-nayana jini — surpassing a doe's eyes; nayana-yugala — the pair of eyes; gridhinira karna jini — surpassing a vulture's ears; karna manohara — the charming ears

111Her eyes surpass the eyes of a doe;
her charming ears surpass the ears of a vulture7.

অধর বান্ধুলী জিনি অনুপম-শোভা ।
দশন মোতিম জিনি ঝলমল আভা ॥ ১১২ ॥

adhara bāndhulī jini anupama-śobhā |
daśana motima jini jhalamala ābhā || 112 ||

adhara — the lips; bandhuli jini — surpassing bandhuli flowers; anupama-shobha — peerless beauty; dashana — the teeth; motima jini — surpassing pearls; jhalamala abha — glittering lustre

112Her lips surpass bandhuli flowers — a peerless beauty;
her teeth surpass pearls — a glittering lustre.

কম্বুকণ্ঠ জিনিয়া জগত-মনোহারী ।
সিংহগ্রীব জিনিয়া সুন্দর গ্রীবাধারী ॥ ১১৩ ॥

kambukaṇṭha jiniẏā jagata-manohārī |
siṃhagrība jiniẏā sundara grībādhārī || 113 ||

kambu-kantha jiniya — the throat, surpassing the conch; jagata-manohari — enchanting the world; simha-griva jiniya — surpassing the lion's neck; sundara grivadhari — she has a beautiful neck

113Her throat surpasses the conch, enchanting the world;
surpassing the lion's neck, beautiful is her neck.

বাহুযুগল কনক-মৃণাল-শোভা জিনি ।
করতল রাতা-পদ্ম জিনি অনুমানি ॥ ১১৪ ॥

bāhuyugala kanaka-mṛṇāla-śobhā jini |
karatala rātā-padma jini anumāni || 114 ||

bahu-yugala — the pair of arms; kanaka-mrinala-shobha jini — surpassing the beauty of golden lotus stalks; karatala — the palms; rata-padma jini — surpassing red lotuses; anumani — one would think

114Her arms surpass in beauty golden lotus stalks;
her palms, one would think, surpass red lotuses.

অঙ্গুলি চম্পককলি জিনি মনোহর ।
নখ চন্দ্র জিনি শোভা অতি ঝলমল ॥ ১১৫ ॥

aṅguli campakakali jini manohara |
nakha candra jini śobhā ati jhalamala || 115 ||

anguli — the fingers; champaka-kali jini — surpassing champaka buds; manohara — lovely; nakha — the nails; chandra jini — surpassing the moon; shobha ati jhalamala — their beauty glitters brightly

115Her fingers are lovelier than champaka buds;
her nails surpass the moon, their beauty glitters.

বক্ষঃস্থল-পরিসর সুমেরু জিনিয়া ।
কেশরী জিনিয়া মাজা অতি সে ক্ষীণিয়া ॥ ১১৬ ॥

bakṣaḥsthala-parisara sumeru jiniẏā |
keśarī jiniẏā mājā ati se kṣīṇiẏā || 116 ||

vakshahsthala-parisara — the breadth of the bosom; sumeru jiniya — surpassing Sumeru; keshari jiniya — surpassing the lion; maja — the waist; ati se kshiniya — very slender

116The breadth of her bosom surpasses Sumeru;
her waist surpasses the lion's — so very slender.

কামদেব-রথচক্র জিনিয়া নিতম্ব ।
ঊরুযুগ জিনি রাম-কদলক-স্তম্ভ ॥ ১১৭ ॥

kāmadeba-rathacakra jiniẏā nitamba |
ūruyuga jini rāma-kadalaka-stambha || 117 ||

kamadeva-ratha-chakra jiniya — surpassing the wheel of Kamadeva's chariot; nitamba — the hips; uru-yuga — the pair of thighs; jini — surpasses; rama-kadalaka-stambha — the trunks of the ramakadali plantain

117Her hips surpass the wheel of Kamadeva's chariot,
her thighs the trunks of the ramakadali plantain.

ত্রৈলোক্য জিনিয়া রূপ গড়িল বিধাতা ।
ডগমগ করে পদতল পদ্ম-রাতা ॥ ১১৮ ॥

trailokya jiniẏā rūpa gaṛila bidhātā |
ḍagamaga kare padatala padma-rātā || 118 ||

trailokya jiniya — surpassing the three worlds; rupa gadila vidhata — the Creator fashioned the beauty; dagamaga kare — glow; padatala — the soles of the feet; padma-rata — red as the lotus

118The Creator fashioned a beauty surpassing the three worlds;
the soles of her feet, red as the lotus, glow.

নখচন্দ্র-পাঁতি জিনি অকলঙ্ক-চাঁদে ।
তাহার কিরণে আঁখি পাইল জন্ম-অন্ধে ॥ ১১৯ ॥

nakhacandra-pāṁti jini akalaṅka-cāṁde |
tāhāra kiraṇe āṁkhi pāila janma-andhe || 119 ||

nakha-chandra-panti — the row of moon-like nails; jini akalanka-chande — surpasses the spotless moon; tahara kirane — by their rays; ankhi paila — received sight; janma-andhe — one blind from birth

119The row of her moon-like nails surpasses the spotless moon;
by their rays even one blind from birth received sight.

গন্ধ চন্দন মাল্যে করাইল বেশ ।
বিনি বেশে অঙ্গছটা আলো করে দেশ ॥ ১২০ ॥

gandha candana mālye karāila beśa |
bini beśe aṅgachaṭā ālo kare deśa || 120 ||

gandha chandana malye — with scents, sandal and garlands; karaila vesha — they arrayed her; vini veshe — without adornment; anga-chhata — the radiance of her body; alo kare desha — lights up the land

120She was arrayed with scents, sandal and garlands;
yet even without adornment the radiance of her body lights up the land.

ত্রৈলোক্য-মোহিনী জিনি কন্যা পার্বতী ।
অঙ্গ-অলঙ্কারে ঝলমল করে ক্ষিতি ॥ ১২১ ॥

trailokya-mohinī jini kanyā pārbatī |
aṅga-alaṅkāre jhalamala kare kṣiti || 121 ||

trailokya-mohini — enchanting the three worlds; jini — surpasses; kanya — the maiden; parvati — Parvati; anga-alankare — by the ornaments on her body; jhalamala kare kshiti — the earth glitters

121The maiden who enchants the three worlds surpasses Parvati;
by her ornaments the earth glitters.

হেনকালে শুভলগ্ন সময় বুঝিয়া ।
বর আনিবারে বিপ্র দিল পাঠাইয়া ॥ ১২২ ॥

henakāle śubhalagna samaẏa bujhiẏā |
bara ānibāre bipra dila pāṭhāiẏā || 122 ||

henakale — then; shubha-lagna samaya bujhiya — understanding that the auspicious hour had come; bara anibare — to bring the bridegroom; vipra dila pathaiya — sent a brahmana

122Then, seeing that the auspicious hour had come,
[Sanatana] sent a brahmana to bring the bridegroom.

ব্রাহ্মণ প্রভুর আগে দাণ্ডাইয়া রহে ।
পাঠাইল দ্বিজ মোরে সবিনয়ে কহে ॥ ১২৩ ॥

brāhmaṇa prabhura āge dāṇḍāiẏā rahe |
pāṭhāila dbija more sabinaẏe kahe || 123 ||

brahmana — the brahmana; prabhura age — before the Lord; dandaiya rahe — stood; pathaila dvija more — the brahmana has sent me; savinaye kahe — he says humbly

123The brahmana stood before the Lord
and humbly says: "The brahmana [Sanatana] has sent me."

অঙ্গ-ঝলমল-তেজ দেখিয়া ব্রাহ্মণ ।
আপনাকে ধন্য মানে ধন্য সনাতন ॥ ১২৪ ॥

aṅga-jhalamala-teja dekhiẏā brāhmaṇa |
āpanāke dhanya māne dhanya sanātana || 124 ||

anga-jhalamala-teja — the dazzling radiance of the body; dekhiya brahmana — seeing, the brahmana; apanake dhanya mane — considers himself blessed; dhanya sanatana — blessed is Sanatana

124Seeing the dazzling radiance of His body, the brahmana
considers himself blessed: "Blessed is Sanatana too!"

কহিল প্রভুর আগে শুন বিশ্বম্ভর ।
নিকট হইল লগ্ন চলহ সত্বর ॥ ১২৫ ॥

kahila prabhura āge śuna biśbambhara |
nikaṭa haila lagna calaha satbara || 125 ||

kahila prabhura age — he said before the Lord; shuna vishvambhara — listen, Vishvambhara; nikata haila lagna — the auspicious hour is near; chalaha satvara — come quickly

125He said before the Lord: "Listen, Vishvambhara:
the auspicious hour is near — come quickly.

আমি কি কহিতে জানি তোমার সম্মুখে ।
তুমি দেব ভগবান্ দেখি পরতেকে ॥ ১২৬ ॥

āmi ki kahite jāni tomāra sammukhe |
tumi deba bhagabān dekhi parateke || 126 ||

ami ki kahite jani — what can I say; tomara sammukhe — in Your presence; tumi deva bhagavan — You are God, Bhagavan; dekhi parateke — I see it with my own eyes

126What can I say in Your presence?
You are God, Bhagavan: I see it with my own eyes."

তবে সেই শুভক্ষণে বিশ্বম্ভর পহুঁ ।
চলিলা মনুষ্যযানে হাসে লহু লহু ॥ ১২৭ ॥

tabe sei śubhakṣaṇe biśbambhara pahuṁ |
calilā manuṣyayāne hāse lahu lahu || 127 ||

tabe — then; sei shubha-kshane — at that auspicious moment; vishvambhara pahun — the Lord Vishvambhara; chalila manushya-yane — set out in a palanquin; hase lahu lahu — gently smiling

127Then at that auspicious moment the Lord Vishvambhara
set out in a palanquin, gently smiling.

আইও সুও লঞা শচী আশীর্বাদ করে ।
মাতৃ-পদধূলি প্রভু লই নিজ শিরে ॥ ১২৮ ॥

āio suo lañā śacī āśīrbāda kare |
mātṛ-padadhūli prabhu lai nija śire || 128 ||

aio suo lana — with the married women; shachi ashirvada kare — Shachi gives her blessing; matri-padadhuli — the dust of the mother's feet; prabhu lai nija shire — the Lord took upon His head

128Shachi with the married women gives her blessing;
the Lord took the dust of His mother's feet upon His head.

শঙ্খ দুন্দুভি বাজে ভেউর কাহাল ।
দণ্ডিম মুহুরি বাজে ডিণ্ডিম রসাল ॥ ১২৯ ॥

śaṅkha dundubhi bāje bheura kāhāla |
daṇḍima muhuri bāje ḍiṇḍima rasāla || 129 ||

shankha — conches; dundubhi — dundubhis; baje — sound; bheura kahala — bheurs and kahals; dandima — dandimas (?); muhuri — muharis; dindima rasala — sweet dindimas

129Conches, dundubhis, bheurs and kahals sound,
dandimas and muharis sound, dindimas sound sweetly8.

বীণা বেণু কপিলাস রবাব উপাঙ্গ ।
মিলিয়া বাজয়ে সব পাখোয়াজ এক-সঙ্গ ॥ ১৩০ ॥

bīṇā beṇu kapilāsa rabāba upāṅga |
miliẏā bājaẏe saba pākhoẏāja eka-saṅga || 130 ||

vina — vinas; venu — flutes; kapilasa — kapilasas; rababa — rababs; upanga — upangas; miliya bajaye saba — all play together; pakhoyaja — pakhoyajs; eka-sanga — at once

130Vinas, flutes, kapilasas, rababs, upangas
and pakhoyajs all play together.

পটহ মৃদঙ্গ বাজে কাংস্য করতাল ।
শিঙ্গা বরগো বাজে সাহিনী মিশাল ॥ ১৩১ ॥

paṭaha mṛdaṅga bāje kāṃsya karatāla |
śiṅgā barago bāje sāhinī miśāla || 131 ||

pataha mridanga baje — patahas and mridangas sound; kamsya karatala — bronze cymbals and karatalas; shinga bargo baje — shingas and bargos sound; sahini mishala — mingled with sahinis

131Patahas and mridangas, bronze cymbals and karatalas sound,
shingas and bargos sound together with the sahinis.

নানাবিধ বাদ্য বাজে নাম নাহি জানি ।
সম্মুখে নাটুয়া নাচে শুনি বেদধ্বনি ॥ ১৩২ ॥

nānābidha bādya bāje nāma nāhi jāni |
sammukhe nāṭuẏā nāce śuni bedadhbani || 132 ||

nanavidha vadya baje — all kinds of instruments sound; nama nahi jani — I do not know their names; sammukhe — in front; natuya nache — dancers dance; shuni veda-dhvani — the chanting of the Vedas is heard

132All kinds of instruments sound — I do not know their names;
in front dancers dance, the chanting of the Vedas is heard.

গায়নেতে গীত গায় ভাটে কায়বার ।
বয়স্যে বেষ্টিত প্রভু কৈল আগুসার ॥ ১৩৩ ॥

gāẏanete gīta gāẏa bhāṭe kāẏabāra |
baẏasye beṣṭita prabhu kaila āgusāra || 133 ||

gayanete gita gaya — singers sing songs; bhate kayabara — the bhats [sing] praises; vayasye veshtita — surrounded by friends; prabhu kaila agusara — the Lord moved forward

133Singers sing songs, the bhat bards sing praises;
surrounded by His friends, the Lord moved forward.

নদীয়া-নগরে ঘরে ঘরে পড়ে সাড়া ।
দেখিবারে ধায় লোক দিয়া বাহু-নাড়া ॥ ১৩৪ ॥

nadīẏā-nagare ghare ghare paṛe sāṛā |
dekhibāre dhāẏa loka diẏā bāhu-nāṛā || 134 ||

nadiya-nagare — in the town of Nadia; ghare ghare pade sada — every house is astir; dekhibare dhaya loka — people run to look; diya bahu-nada — waving their arms

134In the town of Nadia every house was astir;
people run to look, waving their arms.

Raga bihagara

পাটশাড়ী পরে, নেতের কাঁচুলী,
কানড়-ছান্দে বান্ধে খোঁপা ।
মুকুতা গাঁথিয়া, সোনায়ে বান্ধিয়া,
পিঠে ফেলে রাঙা থোপা ॥ ১৩৫ ॥

pāṭaśāṛī pare, netera kāṁculī,
kānaṛa-chānde bāndhe khoṁpā |
mukutā gāṁthiẏā, sonāẏe bāndhiẏā,
piṭhe phele rāṅā thopā || 135 ||

patashadi pare — put on silk saris; netera kanchuli — bodices of fine cloth; kanada-chhande — in the kanada style; bandhe khonpa — tie a hair-knot; mukuta ganthiya — stringing pearls; sonaye bandhiya — setting them in gold; pithe — on the back; phele ranga thopa — let red tassels fall

135They put on silk saris and bodices of fine cloth,
tie their hair in a knot in the kanada style;
stringing pearls and setting them in gold,
they let red tassels fall down their backs.

ধনি ধনি ধনি, নদীয়া-নাগরী,
আনন্দ-পাথারে নীত ।
বিশ্বম্ভর-বিভা, চল দেখি যাঞা,
গাব সুমঙ্গল গীত ॥ ১৩৬ ॥

dhani dhani dhani, nadīẏā-nāgarī,
ānanda-pāthāre nīta |
biśbambhara-bibhā, cala dekhi yāñā,
gāba sumaṅgala gīta || 136 ||

dhani dhani dhani — beauties, beauties; nadiya-nagari — the ladies of Nadia; ananda-pathare nita — carried into an ocean of joy; vishvambhara-bibha — Vishvambhara's wedding; chala dekhi yana — let us go and see; gaba sumangala gita — we will sing auspicious songs

136The beauties, the beauties — the ladies of Nadia —
are carried away into an ocean of joy:
"Let us go and see Vishvambhara's wedding,
we will sing auspicious songs!"

কেহো ত কাপড়, পাটশাড়ী পরে,
শ্রবণে গন্ধরাজ চাঁপা ।
গজেন্দ্র-গমনে, চলিতে না জানে,
কুরঙ্গ-দিঠে চাহে বাঁকা ॥ ১৩৭ ॥

keho ta kāpaṛa, pāṭaśāṛī pare,
śrabaṇe gandharāja cāṁpā |
gajendra-gamane, calite nā jāne,
kuraṅga-diṭhe cāhe bāṁkā || 137 ||

keho ta kapada — some, garments; patashadi pare — put on silk saris; shravane — in the ears; gandharaja chanpa — gandharaja and champaka; gajendra-gamane — with the gait of a king of elephants; chalite na jane — cannot walk [fast]; kuranga-dithe — with a doe's glance; chahe banka — look sidelong

137Some put on garments, silk saris,
gandharaja and champaka flowers in their ears;
they move with an elephant's stately gait — they cannot walk fast —
and glance sidelong with the eyes of a doe.

অঞ্জনে রঞ্জিত, খঞ্জন-নয়ন,
চঞ্চল তারক জোর ।
গোরা-রূপ-পঙ্কে, পঙ্কিল আলসে,
আর না চলিব ভোর ॥ ১৩৮ ॥

añjane rañjita, khañjana-naẏana,
cañcala tāraka jora |
gorā-rūpa-paṅke, paṅkila ālase,
āra nā caliba bhora || 138 ||

anjane ranjita — tinged with kajal; khanjana-nayana — wagtail eyes; chanchala taraka jora — a restless pair of pupils; gora-rupa-panke — in the mire of Gora's beauty; pankila — sunk; alase — languid; ara na chaliba — will move no more; bhora — entranced

138Their wagtail eyes, tinged with kajal, —
a restless pair of pupils —
have sunk in the mire of Gora's beauty
and, languid and entranced, will move no more.

নগরে নগরে, যতেক নাগরী,
ধাইল ধ্বনি শুনিয়া ।
চিকুরে চিরুণী, চলিল তরুণী,
চীর না সম্বরে ভুলিয়া ॥ ১৩৯ ॥

nagare nagare, yateka nāgarī,
dhāila dhbani śuniẏā |
cikure ciruṇī, calila taruṇī,
cīra nā sambare bhuliẏā || 139 ||

nagare nagare — in every quarter; yateka nagari — all the ladies of the town; dhaila dhvani shuniya — hearing the sound, ran out; chikure chiruni — combs in their hair; chalila taruni — the girls went; chira na sambare bhuliya — forgetting to arrange their clothes

139In every quarter all the ladies of the town,
hearing the sound, ran out;
young girls ran with combs in their hair,
forgetting to arrange their clothes.

নবীন যুবতী, ছাড়ি পতি-মতি,
ছাড়ি কুল-বন্ধুজন ।
বসন-ভূষণ, না সম্বরে যেন,
সতত উনমত হেন ॥ ১৪০ ॥

nabīna yubatī, chāṛi pati-mati,
chāṛi kula-bandhujana |
basana-bhūṣaṇa, nā sambare yena,
satata unamata hena || 140 ||

navina yuvati — young women; chhadi pati-mati — abandoning thoughts of their husbands; chhadi kula-bandhu-jana — leaving family and kin; vasana-bhushana na sambare — do not arrange clothes and ornaments; yena satata unamata hena — as though forever maddened

140Young women, abandoning thoughts of their husbands,
leaving their families and kin,
do not arrange their clothes or ornaments,
as though forever maddened9.

থির বিজুরী, যেমন গমন,
গমন মরাল-বধূ ।
সারি সারি সারি, হাত-ধরাধরি,
যেমন শারদ-বিধু ॥ ১৪১ ॥

thira bijurī, yemana gamana,
gamana marāla-badhū |
sāri sāri sāri, hāta-dharādhari,
yemana śārada-bidhu || 141 ||

thira bijuri — motionless lightning; yemana gamana — such is the gait; gamana marala-vadhu — the gait of she-swans; sari sari sari — row upon row; hata-dharadhari — holding hands; yemana sharada-vidhu — like autumn moons

141Like motionless lightning — such is their gait,
the gait of she-swans;
row upon row, holding hands,
they are like autumn moons.

কি নারী পুরুষ, ধায় একমুখ,
কেহ কাহো নাহি মানে ।
ঠেলাঠেলি পথে, ধায় উনমতে,
দেখিতে গৌরাঙ্গ-বদনে ॥ ১৪২ ॥

ki nārī puruṣa, dhāẏa ekamukha,
keha kāho nāhi māne |
ṭhelāṭheli pathe, dhāẏa unamate,
dekhite gaurāṅga-badane || 142 ||

ki nari purusha — whether women or men; dhaya ekamukha — run in one direction; keha kaho nahi mane — no one heeds anyone; thelatheli pathe — jostling on the road; dhaya unamate — run in a frenzy; dekhite gauranga-vadane — to see Gauranga's face

142Women or men — all run in one direction,
no one heeds anyone;
jostling on the road, they run in a frenzy
to see the face of Gauranga.

নদীয়া-নগর, আনন্দ-সাগর,
গৌরাঙ্গ নাগর-ধন ।
চৌদিকে ধাওয়া-ধাই, বাজয়ে বাধাই,
কুরঙ্গ-রঙ্গিণী যেন ॥ ১৪২+১ ॥

nadīẏā-nagara, ānanda-sāgara,
gaurāṅga nāgara-dhana |
caudike dhāoẏā-dhāi, bājaẏe bādhāi,
kuraṅga-raṅgiṇī yena || 142+1 ||

nadiya-nagara — the town of Nadia; ananda-sagara — an ocean of joy; gauranga nagara-dhana — Gauranga, the treasure-nagara; chaudike dhaoya-dhai — running on all sides; bajaye badhai — festive music sounds; kuranga-rangini yena — like playful does

142+1The town of Nadia is an ocean of joy,
Gauranga is the treasure-nagara;
on all sides people run, festive music sounds —
[the women] are like playful does10.

বাল বৃদ্ধ অন্ধ, পঙ্গু ভেঙুর,
আতুর দেখয়ে সাধে ।
কেহ কেহ বন্ধু-করে কর দিয়া,
ধায় চীর নাহি বান্ধে ॥ ১৪৩ ॥

bāla bṛddha andha, paṅgu bheṅura,
ātura dekhaẏe sādhe |
keha keha bandhu-kare kara diẏā,
dhāẏa cīra nāhi bāndhe || 143 ||

bala vriddha andha — children, the old, the blind; pangu bhengura — the lame, the crippled; atura — the sick; dekhaye sadhe — look with longing; keha keha — some; bandhu-kare kara diya — joining hands with friends; dhaya — run; chira nahi bandhe — without tying their clothes

143Children, the old, the blind, the lame, the crippled,
the sick look on with longing;
some, joining hands with their friends,
run without tying their clothes.

মদন-বেদনে, বদন দেখিয়া,
অধীর হইল নারী ।
পশু পক্ষী সব, গৌরাঙ্গ দেখিয়া,
রহে সভে সারি সারি ॥ ১৪৪ ॥

madana-bedane, badana dekhiẏā,
adhīra haila nārī |
paśu pakṣī saba, gaurāṅga dekhiẏā,
rahe sabhe sāri sāri || 144 ||

madana-vedane — in the pangs of Madana; vadana dekhiya — seeing the face; adhira haila nari — the women lost composure; pashu pakshi saba — all beasts and birds; gauranga dekhiya — seeing Gauranga; rahe sabhe sari sari — all stand row upon row

144Seeing His face, the women, in the pangs of Madana,
lose their composure;
all the beasts and birds, seeing Gauranga,
stand still, row upon row.

বয়স্যে বেষ্টিত, দিব্য অলঙ্কৃত,
মুকুট নিকট-ললাটে ।
লোচন বলে হেরি, ভুলল নাগরী,
ঘুচল হিয়া-কপাটে ॥ ১৪৫ ॥

baẏasye beṣṭita, dibya alaṅkṛta,
mukuṭa nikaṭa-lalāṭe |
locana bale heri, bhulala nāgarī,
ghucala hiẏā-kapāṭe || 145 ||

vayasye veshtita — surrounded by friends; divya alankrita — divinely adorned; mukuta nikata-lalate — a crown just above the forehead; lochana bale — Lochana says; heri — seeing; bhulala nagari — the nagaris were bewitched; ghuchala hiya-kapate — the doors of their hearts opened

145Surrounded by friends, divinely adorned,
a crown just above the forehead…
Lochana says: seeing [Him], the nagaris lost their heads,
the doors of their hearts flew open.

Raga varadi; tune "dhulakhela"11

হেনমতে বিশ্বম্ভর, গেলা পণ্ডিতের ঘর,
দ্বিজবর আনন্দ-পাথার ।
পাদ্য অর্ঘ্য লঞা করে, গেলা প্রভু-বরাবরে,
ধন্য ধন্য শচীর কুমার ॥ ১৪৬ ॥

henamate biśbambhara, gelā paṇḍitera ghara,
dbijabara ānanda-pāthāra |
pādya arghya lañā kare, gelā prabhu-barābare,
dhanya dhanya śacīra kumāra || 146 ||

henamate — thus; vishvambhara gela panditera ghara — Vishvambhara came to the pandit's house; dvijavara ananda-pathara — the best of brahmanas, an ocean of joy; padya arghya lana kare — taking in his hands water for the feet and arghya; gela prabhu-barabare — went out to meet the Lord; dhanya dhanya shachira kumara — blessed, blessed is Shachi's son

146Thus Vishvambhara came to the pandit's house;
the best of brahmanas was in an ocean of joy.
Taking in his hands water for the feet and arghya,
he went out to meet the Lord: "Blessed, blessed is Shachi's son!"

তবে পাদ্য অর্ঘ্য দিয়া, গৌরচন্দ্র থুইল লঞা,
দাণ্ডাইল ছোড়লা-ভিতরে ।
সর্বজনে হরি বলে, শত শত দীপ জ্বলে,
তাহে জিনি গৌর-কলেবরে ॥ ১৪৭ ॥

tabe pādya arghya diẏā, gauracandra thuila lañā,
dāṇḍāila choṛalā-bhitare |
sarbajane hari bale, śata śata dīpa jbale,
tāhe jini gaura-kalebare || 147 ||

tabe — then; padya arghya diya — offering water for the feet and arghya; gaurachandra thuila lana — he led Gaurachandra in; dandaila chhorla-bhitare — [He] stood on the wedding platform; sarvajane hari bale — all cry "Hari"; shata shata dipa jvale — hundreds of lamps burn; tahe jini — outshining them; gaura-kalevara — Gaura's body

147Offering water for the feet and arghya, he led Gaurachandra in,
and He stood on the wedding platform.
All cry "Hari!", hundreds upon hundreds of lamps burn,
but Gaura's body outshines them.

উলসিত আইওগণ, হুলাহুলি ঘনে ঘন,
শঙ্খ দুন্দুভি বাদ্য বাজে ।
হেথা আইওগণ মেলি, কেহ পাটশাড়ী পরি,
প্রভু-প্রদক্ষিণ-হেতু সাজে ॥ ১৪৮ ॥

ulasita āiogaṇa, hulāhuli ghane ghana,
śaṅkha dundubhi bādya bāje |
hethā āiogaṇa meli, keha pāṭaśāṛī pari,
prabhu-pradakṣiṇa-hetu sāje || 148 ||

ulasita aio-gana — the married women rejoice; hulahuli ghane ghana — "ulu-ulu" again and again; shankha dundubhi vadya baje — conches, dundubhis and instruments sound; hetha aio-gana meli — there the married women, gathering; keha patashadi pari — some in silk saris; prabhu-pradakshina-hetu saje — adorn themselves to circle the Lord

148The married women rejoice, again and again the "ulu-ulu" cries ring out,
conches, dundubhis and instruments sound;
and there the married women, gathering — some in silk saris —
adorn themselves to circle round the Lord.

নির্মঞ্ছন সজ্জ করি, আইওগণ আগুসারি,
আগুসরে কন্যার জননী ।
ভূমেতে না পড়ে পা, উলসিত সব গা,
দেখি বিশ্বম্ভর গুণমণি ॥ ১৪৯ ॥

nirmañchana sajja kari, āiogaṇa āgusāri,
āgusare kanyāra jananī |
bhūmete nā paṛe pā, ulasita saba gā,
dekhi biśbambhara guṇamaṇi || 149 ||

nirmanchhana sajja kari — preparing all for the nirmanchhana; aio-gana agusari — ahead of the married women; agusare kanyara janani — the bride's mother comes forward; bhumete na pade pa — her feet do not touch the ground; ulasita saba ga — her whole body rejoices; dekhi vishvambhara gunamani — seeing Vishvambhara, the jewel of virtues

149Having prepared all for the nirmanchhana, ahead of the married women
comes the mother of the bride;
her feet do not touch the ground, her whole body rejoices
at the sight of Vishvambhara, the jewel of virtues.

মনে ভাবে গৌরহরি, হিয়ার মাঝারে ভরি,
হৃদয়ে উঠয়ে কত সাধা ।
বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া মোর সুতা, হইব অনুরূপতা,
ভাবিয়া সে মনে দিল বাধা ॥ ১৫০ ॥

mane bhābe gaurahari, hiẏāra mājhāre bhari,
hṛdaẏe uṭhaẏe kata sādhā |
biṣṇupriẏā mora sutā, haiba anurūpatā,
bhābiẏā se mane dila bādhā || 150 ||

mane bhave gaurahari — she thinks of Gaurahari; hiyara majhare bhari — filling her heart [with Him]; hridaye uthaye kata sadha — how many longings rise in her heart; vishnupriya mora suta — Vishnupriya, my daughter; haiba anurupata — will be a match; bhaviya — thinking so; se mane dila badha — she restrained her mind

150Thinking of Gaurahari, filling her heart with Him —
how many longings rise in her heart! —
"Vishnupriya, my daughter, will be a match for Him":
thinking so, she restrained her thoughts12.

একে আইও রূপে জ্বলে, রতন-প্রদীপ করে,
তাহে গোরা-অঙ্গের কিরণে ।
সেই শ্রীঅঙ্গ-গন্ধে, আইও মরে উনমাদে,
হিয়া রাখে অনেক যতনে ॥ ১৫১ ॥

eke āio rūpe jbale, ratana-pradīpa kare,
tāhe gorā-aṅgera kiraṇe |
sei śrīaṅga-gandhe, āio mare unamāde,
hiẏā rākhe aneka yatane || 151 ||

eke — on the one hand; aio rupe jvale — the married women blaze with beauty; ratana-pradipa kare — jewelled lamps in hand; tahe — on top of that; gora-angera kirane — the rays of Gora's body; sei shri-anga-gandhe — by the fragrance of that divine body; aio mare unamade — the women die in frenzy; hiya rakhe aneka yatane — with great effort hold their hearts

151Not only do the married women shine with beauty, with jewelled lamps in their hands, —
on top of that come the rays of Gora's body;
by the fragrance of that body the women all but die in frenzy
and with great effort hold their hearts in check.

সাত প্রদক্ষিণ করাঞা, গোরাচান্দে উরথিয়া,
দধি ঢালে চরণারবিন্দে ।
ঘরে চলিবার বেলে, গোরা-মুখ নেহালে,
পালটিতে নারে অঙ্গ-গন্ধে ॥ ১৫২ ॥

sāta pradakṣiṇa karāñā, gorācānde urathiẏā,
dadhi ḍhāle caraṇārabinde |
ghare calibāra bele, gorā-mukha nehāle,
pālaṭite nāre aṅga-gandhe || 152 ||

sata pradakshina karana — circling seven times; gorachande urathiya — welcoming Gorachand as bridegroom; dadhi dhale charanaravinde — pour curd on His lotus feet; ghare chalibara bele — at the time of going into the house; gora-mukha nehale — they gaze at Gora's face; palatite nare — cannot turn away; anga-gandhe — because of the fragrance of His body

152Having circled Gorachand seven times and welcomed the bridegroom,
they pour curd on His lotus feet;
when the time comes to go back into the house, they gaze at Gora's face —
and cannot turn away: [they are held by] the fragrance of His body.

পণ্ডিত শ্রীসনাতন, করে বর-বরণ,
দিব্য বস্ত্র দিব্য অলঙ্কার ।
দিব্য গন্ধ চন্দন, অঙ্গে করে লেপন,
গলে দিল মালতীর মাল ॥ ১৫৩ ॥

paṇḍita śrīsanātana, kare bara-baraṇa,
dibya bastra dibya alaṅkāra |
dibya gandha candana, aṅge kare lepana,
gale dila mālatīra māla || 153 ||

pandita shri-sanatana — the pandit Sri Sanatana; kare bara-barana — honours the bridegroom; divya vastra — divine garments; divya alankara — divine ornaments; divya gandha chandana — divine scents and sandal; ange kare lepana — anoints the body; gale dila malatira mala — placed a malati garland round His neck

153The pandit Sri Sanatana honours the bridegroom:
divine garments, divine ornaments;
with divine scents and sandal he anoints His body,
he placed a garland of malati round His neck.

সুমেরু-সুন্দর তনু, তাহে সুরধুনী জনু,
দ্বিধা হইয়া বহে দুই ধারা ।
দেখিয়া পণ্ডিত তা, পুলকিত সব গা,
গোরা-অঙ্গে মালতীর মালা ॥ ১৫৪ ॥

sumeru-sundara tanu, tāhe suradhunī janu,
dbidhā haiẏā bahe dui dhārā |
dekhiẏā paṇḍita tā, pulakita saba gā,
gorā-aṅge mālatīra mālā || 154 ||

sumeru-sundara tanu — a body beautiful as Sumeru; tahe suradhuni janu — as if on it the heavenly Ganga; dvidha haiya bahe dui dhara — dividing in two flows in two streams; dekhiya pandita ta — seeing this, the pandit; pulakita saba ga — thrilled all over; gora-ange malatira mala — a malati garland on Gora's body

154His body is beautiful as Sumeru — and as if the heavenly Ganga,
dividing in two, were flowing in two streams:
a garland of malati on the body of Gora!
Seeing this, the pandit thrilled all over with joy13.

তবে সেই সনাতন, মিশ্র দ্বিজ-রতন,
কন্যা আনিবারে আজ্ঞা দিল ।
রত্নসিংহাসনে বসি, ত্রৈলোক্য-রূপসী,
অঙ্গ-ছটায় বিজুরী পড়িল ॥ ১৫৫ ॥

tabe sei sanātana, miśra dbija-ratana,
kanyā ānibāre ājñā dila |
ratnasiṃhāsane basi, trailokya-rūpasī,
aṅga-chaṭāẏa bijurī paṛila || 155 ||

tabe sei sanatana mishra — then Sanatana Mishra; dvija-ratana — jewel among brahmanas; kanya anibare ajna dila — ordered the daughter to be brought; ratna-simhasane basi — seated on a jewelled throne; trailokya-rupasi — the beauty of the three worlds; anga-chhataya — by the radiance of her body; bijuri padila — lightning flashed

155Then Sanatana Mishra, jewel among brahmanas,
ordered his daughter to be brought;
the beauty of the three worlds sits on a jewelled throne —
from the radiance of her body it was as if lightning flashed.

প্রভুর নিকটে আনি, জগ-মন-মোহিনী,
বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া মহালক্ষ্মী-নামা ।
তরল নয়ান বঙ্ক, হেরি মুখ গৌরাঙ্গ,
মন্দ মন্দ হাসি অনুপমা ॥ ১৫৬ ॥

prabhura nikaṭe āni, jaga-mana-mohinī,
biṣṇupriẏā mahālakṣmī-nāmā |
tarala naẏāna baṅka, heri mukha gaurāṅga,
manda manda hāsi anupamā || 156 ||

prabhura nikate ani — bringing her to the Lord; jaga-mana-mohini — enchantress of the world's mind; vishnupriya mahalakshmi-nama — Vishnupriya, named Mahalakshmi; tarala nayana banka — tremulous, playful eyes; heri mukha gauranga — she looks at Gauranga's face; manda manda hasi anupama — with a gentle, peerless smile

156They brought her to the Lord — she who enchants the mind of the world,
Vishnupriya, whose name is Mahalakshmi14;
with tremulous, playful eyes she looks at Gauranga's face
with a gentle, peerless smile.

প্রভু-প্রদক্ষিণ করি, সাতবার চৌদিকে ফিরি,
করজোড়ে করে নমস্কার ।
অন্তঃপট ঘুচাইল, চারি-চক্ষে দেখা হৈল,
দোঁহে করে কুসুম-বিহার ॥ ১৫৭ ॥

prabhu-pradakṣiṇa kari, sātabāra caudike phiri,
karajoṛe kare namaskāra |
antaḥpaṭa ghucāila, cāri-cakṣe dekhā haila,
doṁhe kare kusuma-bihāra || 157 ||

prabhu-pradakshina kari — circling the Lord; satabara chaudike phiri — going round seven times; karajode kare namaskara — bows with joined palms; antahpata ghuchaila — the screen was removed; chari-chakshe dekha haila — four eyes met; donhe kare kusuma-vihara — both play with flowers

157Circling the Lord, going round Him seven times,
she bows [to Him] with joined palms;
the screen between them was removed — four eyes met;
both shower each other with flowers.

উঠিল আনন্দ-রোল, সভে হরি হরি বোল,
ছামুনি নাড়িল কন্যা-বর ।
সভে বলে ধনি ধনি, যেন চান্দ-রোহিণী,
কেহ বলে পার্বতী-শঙ্কর ॥ ১৫৮ ॥

uṭhila ānanda-rola, sabhe hari hari bola,
chāmuni nāṛila kanyā-bara |
sabhe bale dhani dhani, yena cānda-rohiṇī,
keha bale pārbatī-śaṅkara || 158 ||

uthila ananda-rola — cries of joy arose; sabhe hari hari bola — all say "Hari, Hari"; chhamuni nadila — waved the chhamuni; kanya-bara — the bride and bridegroom; sabhe bale dhani dhani — all say "Wonderful, wonderful!"; yena chanda-rohini — like the Moon and Rohini; keha bale — some say; parvati-shankara — Parvati and Shankara

158Cries of joy arose, all repeat: "Hari, Hari!";
the bridegroom and bride waved the chhamuni15;
all say: "Wonderful, wonderful! — like the Moon and Rohini";
some say: "Parvati and Shankara."

তবে বিশ্বম্ভর পহুঁ, মুচকি হাসিয়া লহু,
বসিলা উত্তম সিংহাসনে ।
সনাতন দ্বিজবরে, কন্যা সম্প্রদান করে,
পদাম্বুজে কৈল সমর্পণে ॥ ১৫৯ ॥

tabe biśbambhara pahuṁ, mucaki hāsiẏā lahu,
basilā uttama siṃhāsane |
sanātana dbijabare, kanyā sampradāna kare,
padāmbuje kaila samarpaṇe || 159 ||

tabe vishvambhara pahun — then the Lord Vishvambhara; muchaki hasiya lahu — gently smiling; basila uttama simhasane — sat on an excellent throne; sanatana dvijavare — Sanatana, the best of brahmanas; kanya sampradana kare — gives away his daughter; padambuje kaila samarpane — offered [her] at His lotus feet

159Then the Lord Vishvambhara, gently smiling,
sat on an excellent throne;
Sanatana, the best of brahmanas, gives away his daughter,
offering her at His lotus feet.

যথাযোগ্য যে আছিল, নানাদ্রব্য দান দিল,
একত্র বসিলা দুইজনে ।
বিবাহ-অন্তরে দোঁহে, সনাতন-দ্বিজগৃহে,
একবারে করিলা ভোজনে ॥ ১৬০ ॥

yathāyogya ye āchila, nānādrabya dāna dila,
ekatra basilā duijane |
bibāha-antare doṁhe, sanātana-dbijagṛhe,
ekabāre karilā bhojane || 160 ||

yathayogya ye achhila — all that was fitting; nanadravya dana dila — he presented various gifts; ekatra basila duijane — the two sat together; vivaha-antare — after the wedding; donhe — the two; sanatana-dvija-grihe — in the house of the brahmana Sanatana; ekabare karila bhojane — ate together

160All that was fitting — all kinds of gifts — he presented;
the two sat together.
After the wedding the two, in the house of the brahmana Sanatana,
ate together.

উলসিত আইহগণ, যুক্তি করে মনে মন,
করে করি তাম্বূল কর্পূর ।
দেখিল নয়ান ভরি, শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গচান্দ হরি,
বাসরঘরে বসিলা ঠাকুর ॥ ১৬১ ॥

ulasita āihagaṇa, yukti kare mane mana,
kare kari tāmbūla karpūra |
dekhila naẏāna bhari, śrīgaurāṅgacānda hari,
bāsaraghare basilā ṭhākura || 161 ||

ulasita aiha-gana — the joyful married women; yukti kare mane mana — plot among themselves; kare kari tambula karpura — taking betel and camphor in hand; dekhila nayana bhari — gazed their fill; shri-gaurangachanda hari — at Sri Gaurangachand Hari; basara-ghare basila thakura — the Thakura sat in the bridal chamber

161The joyful married women plot among themselves,
taking betel and camphor in their hands;
they gazed their fill at Sri Gaurangachand Hari, —
the Thakura sat in the bridal chamber.

বিশ্বম্ভর বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া, বাসরে বসিল গিয়া,
আইহগণে মনে অনুমানে ।
এই লক্ষ্মী বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া, বিষ্ণু বিশ্বম্ভর হঞা,
পৃথিবীতে কৈল অবধানে ॥ ১৬২ ॥

biśbambhara biṣṇupriẏā, bāsare basila giẏā,
āihagaṇe mane anumāne |
ei lakṣmī biṣṇupriẏā, biṣṇu biśbambhara hañā,
pṛthibīte kaila abadhāne || 162 ||

vishvambhara vishnupriya — Vishvambhara and Vishnupriya; basare basila giya — went and sat in the bridal chamber; aiha-gane mane anumane — the married women think to themselves; ei lakshmi vishnupriya — this Vishnupriya is Lakshmi; vishnu vishvambhara hana — Vishnu, having become Vishvambhara; prithivite kaila avadhane — have come to the earth

162Vishvambhara and Vishnupriya went and sat in the bridal chamber,
and the married women think to themselves:
"This Vishnupriya is Lakshmi, and Vishnu has become Vishvambhara —
thus They have come to the earth."

নানাবিধ জানে কলা, করে করি দিব্যমালা,
তুলি দেই বিশ্বম্ভর-গলে ।
কেহ অভিলাষ করে, যে আছিল অন্তরে,
মনঃকথা বিকাইনু তোরে ॥ ১৬৩ ॥

nānābidha jāne kalā, kare kari dibyamālā,
tuli dei biśbambhara-gale |
keha abhilāṣa kare, ye āchila antare,
manaḥkathā bikāinu tore || 163 ||

nanavidha jane kala — skilled in all kinds of arts; kare kari divya-mala — taking divine garlands in hand; tuli dei vishvambhara-gale — put them round Vishvambhara's neck; keha abhilasha kare — some express desire; ye achhila antare — that was in their hearts; manah-katha — my secret; bikainu tore — I have sold myself to You

163Those skilled in all the arts, taking divine garlands in their hands,
put them round Vishvambhara's neck;
some voice the desire that was in their hearts:
"This is my secret: I have sold myself to You"16.

কেহো গন্ধ চন্দন, অঙ্গে করে লেপন,
পরশিতে বাড়ে উনমাদ ।
করি নানা পরসঙ্গে, লোলি পড়য়ে অঙ্গে,
পূরাইল জনমের সাধ ॥ ১৬৪ ॥

keho gandha candana, aṅge kare lepana,
paraśite bāṛe unamāda |
kari nānā parasaṅge, loli paṛaẏe aṅge,
pūrāila janamera sādha || 164 ||

keho gandha chandana — some, with scents and sandal; ange kare lepana — anoint the body; parashite bade unamada — at the touch their frenzy grows; kari nana parasange — starting all sorts of talk; loli padaye ange — lean against the body; puraila janamera sadha — the desire of a lifetime was fulfilled

164Some anoint His body with scents and sandal —
at the touch their frenzy grows;
starting all sorts of talk, they lean against His body —
thus the desire of their whole life was fulfilled.

পরম সুন্দরী যত, সবে হৈলা উনমত,
বেকত করয়ে মনঃকথা ।
রসের আবেশে হাসে, ঢলি পড়ে গোরা-পাশে,
গরগর কামে উনমতা ॥ ১৬৪+১ ॥

parama sundarī yata, sabe hailā unamata,
bekata karaẏe manaḥkathā |
rasera ābeśe hāse, ḍhali paṛe gorā-pāśe,
garagara kāme unamatā || 164+1 ||

parama sundari yata — all the beauties there were; sabe haila unamata — all grew frenzied; vekata karaye manahkatha — openly speak their hearts' secrets; rasera aveshe hase — rapt in rasa they laugh; dhali pade gora-pashe — swaying, lean against Gora; garagara kame unamata — maddened, overwhelmed by kama

164+1All the beauties who were there grew frenzied
and openly speak their hearts' secrets;
rapt in rasa they laugh and, swaying, lean against Gora,
maddened, overwhelmed by desire (kama)17.

কেহো বাটা ভরি তাম্বূলে, দেই প্রভু-পদমূলে,
করে দেই কুসুম-অঞ্জলি ।
তার মনঃকথা এই, জন্ম জন্ম প্রভু তুঞি,
আত্ম সমর্পয়ে ইহা বলি ॥ ১৬৫ ॥

keho bāṭā bhari tāmbūle, dei prabhu-padamūle,
kare dei kusuma-añjali |
tāra manaḥkathā ei, janma janma prabhu tuñi,
ātma samarpaẏe ihā bali || 165 ||

keho bata bhari tambule — one, filling a tray with betel; dei prabhu-pada-mule — sets it at the Lord's feet; kare dei kusuma-anjali — offers a handful of flowers; tara manah-katha ei — this is what is in her heart; janma janma prabhu tuni — You are the Lord birth after birth; atma samarpaye iha bali — saying so, she gives herself

165One, filling a tray with betel, sets it at the Lord's feet
and offers a handful of flowers;
this is what is in her heart: "You are my Lord birth after birth" —
saying so, she gives herself [to Him].

এইমতে রজনী, গোঙাইলা গুণমণি,
আইহগণ-ভাগ্যের প্রকাশে ।
প্রভাতে উঠিয়া বিধি, কৈল প্রভু গুণনিধি,
কুশণ্ডিকা-কর্ম সে-দিবসে ॥ ১৬৬ ॥

eimate rajanī, goṅāilā guṇamaṇi,
āihagaṇa-bhāgyera prakāśe |
prabhāte uṭhiẏā bidhi, kaila prabhu guṇanidhi,
kuśaṇḍikā-karma se-dibase || 166 ||

eimate rajani gonaila — thus spent the night; gunamani — the jewel of virtues; aiha-gana-bhagyera prakashe — the good fortune of the married women was revealed; prabhate uthiya — rising in the morning; vidhi — duly; kaila prabhu gunanidhi — the Lord, the treasury of virtues, performed; kushandika-karma — the kushandika rite; se-divase — that same day

166Thus the jewel of virtues spent the night —
the good fortune of the married women was revealed;
in the morning, rising, the Lord, the treasury of virtues,
duly performed that same day the rite of kushandika18.

তার-পর-দিনে পহুঁ, বসিলা ত বামে বধূ,
ঘরে চলিব হৈল বাণী ।
পরিজনে পূজা করে, যার যেই মনে ধরে,
জয় জয় হৈল শঙ্খধ্বনি ॥ ১৬৭ ॥

tāra-para-dine pahuṁ, basilā ta bāme badhū,
ghare caliba haila bāṇī |
parijane pūjā kare, yāra yei mane dhare,
jaẏa jaẏa haila śaṅkhadhbani || 167 ||

tara-para-dine — on the next day; pahun — the Lord; basila ta bame vadhu — with the bride seated at His left; ghare chaliba haila vani — said "I shall go home"; parijane puja kare — the household honour [Him]; yara yei mane dhare — each as he wished; jaya jaya haila shankha-dhvani — "Jaya, jaya!" and the sound of conches arose

167On the next day the Lord, seating the bride at His left,
said: "I shall go home."
The household honour [Him] — each as he wished;
cries of "Jaya, jaya!" and the sound of conches arose.

গুবাক চন্দন মালা, করে দিয়া দোঁহে গেলা,
সনাতন ব্রাহ্মণ ব্রাহ্মণী ।
শিরে দেই দূর্বা ধান, করে শুভ কল্যাণ,
চিরজীবী আশীর্বাদ-বাণী ॥ ১৬৮ ॥

gubāka candana mālā, kare diẏā doṁhe gelā,
sanātana brāhmaṇa brāhmaṇī |
śire dei dūrbā dhāna, kare śubha kalyāṇa,
cirajībī āśīrbāda-bāṇī || 168 ||

gubaka chandana mala — betel nuts, sandal, garlands; kare diya donhe gela — placing them in [Their] hands, the two came; sanatana brahmana brahmani — the brahmana Sanatana and his wife; shire dei durva dhana — lay durva and rice on the heads; kare shubha kalyana — wish good and well-being; chirajivi ashirvada-vani — the blessing "Live long!"

168The brahmana Sanatana and his wife, placing in [Their] hands
betel nuts, sandal and garlands,
lay durva grass and rice on Their heads, wish Them good and well-being
and bless Them: "Live long!"

তবে দেবী বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া, তরল হইল হিয়া,
মুখ চাহে জনক জননী ।
সকরুণ-কণ্ঠস্বরে, আত্মনিবেদন করে,
অনুনয়-সবিনয় বাণী ॥ ১৬৯ ॥

tabe debī biṣṇupriẏā, tarala haila hiẏā,
mukha cāhe janaka jananī |
sakaruṇa-kaṇṭhasbare, ātmanibedana kare,
anunaẏa-sabinaẏa bāṇī || 169 ||

tabe devi vishnupriya — then Vishnupriya-devi; tarala haila hiya — her heart trembled; mukha chahe janaka janani — she looks into the faces of father and mother; sakaruna-kanthasvare — in a voice full of tears; atma-nivedana kare — [they] give themselves over; anunaya-savinaya vani — with humble entreaty

169Then the heart of Vishnupriya-devi trembled,
she looks into the faces of her father and mother;
and [they], in a voice full of tears, give themselves over [to the Lord]
with humble entreaty.

সনাতন দ্বিজবর, বোলে হিয়া কাতর,
তোরে আমি কি বলিতে জানি ।
আপনার নিজগুণে, লৈলে মোর কন্যাদানে,
তোর যোগ্য কিবা দিব আমি ॥ ১৭০ ॥

sanātana dbijabara, bole hiẏā kātara,
tore āmi ki balite jāni |
āpanāra nijaguṇe, laile mora kanyādāne,
tora yogya kibā diba āmi || 170 ||

sanatana dvijavara — Sanatana, the best of brahmanas; bole hiya katara — says with an aching heart; tore ami ki balite jani — what can I say to You; apanara nijagune — by Your own goodness; laile mora kanya-dane — You accepted my daughter; tora yogya kiba diba ami — what worthy of You can I give

170Sanatana, the best of brahmanas, says with an aching heart:
"What can I say to You?
By Your own goodness You have accepted my daughter —
what worthy of You can I give?

আর নিবেদিয়ে কথা, তুমি মোর জামাতা,
ধন্য আমি আমার আলয় ।
ধন্য মোর বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া, তোর পাদপদ্ম পাঞা,
ইহা বলি গদগদ হয় ॥ ১৭১ ॥

āra nibediẏe kathā, tumi mora jāmātā,
dhanya āmi āmāra ālaẏa |
dhanya mora biṣṇupriẏā, tora pādapadma pāñā,
ihā bali gadagada haẏa || 171 ||

ara nivediye katha — and I say this too; tumi mora jamata — You are my son-in-law; dhanya ami — blessed am I; amara alaya — [and] my house; dhanya mora vishnupriya — blessed is my Vishnupriya; tora pada-padma pana — having attained Your lotus feet; iha bali gadagada haya — saying this he is choked with emotion

171And I say this too: You are my son-in-law —
blessed am I, blessed is my house;
blessed is my Vishnupriya, having attained Your lotus feet" —
saying this, he is choked with emotion.

বাষ্প-ছলছল আঁখি, অরুণ-বদন দেখি,
গদগদ আধ-আধ বোলে ।
বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া-কর লঞা, বিশ্বম্ভর-করে দিয়া,
ঢল ঢল নয়নের জলে ॥ ১৭২ ॥

bāṣpa-chalachala āṁkhi, aruṇa-badana dekhi,
gadagada ādha-ādha bole |
biṣṇupriẏā-kara lañā, biśbambhara-kare diẏā,
ḍhala ḍhala naẏanera jale || 172 ||

bashpa-chhalachhala ankhi — eyes brimming with tears; aruna-vadana dekhi — the face is seen flushed; gadagada adha-adha bole — speaks haltingly, faltering; vishnupriya-kara lana — taking Vishnupriya's hand; vishvambhara-kare diya — placing it in Vishvambhara's hand; dhala dhala nayanera jale — tears stream from the eyes

172His eyes brim with tears, his face is flushed,
he speaks haltingly, faltering;
taking Vishnupriya's hand, he placed it in Vishvambhara's hand,
and tears stream from his eyes.

তবে পহুঁ শুভক্ষণে, চড়িলা মনুষ্য-যানে,
সর্বজন-হৃদয়-উল্লাস ।
নানাবিধ বাদ্য বাজে, শঙ্খ দুন্দুভি গাজে,
হরিধ্বনি পরশে আকাশ ॥ ১৭৩ ॥

tabe pahuṁ śubhakṣaṇe, caṛilā manuṣya-yāne,
sarbajana-hṛdaẏa-ullāsa |
nānābidha bādya bāje, śaṅkha dundubhi gāje,
haridhbani paraśe ākāśa || 173 ||

tabe pahun shubha-kshane — then the Lord at the auspicious moment; chadila manushya-yane — mounted the palanquin; sarvajana-hridaya-ullasa — the hearts of all rejoice; nanavidha vadya baje — all kinds of instruments sound; shankha dundubhi gaje — conches and dundubhis roar; hari-dhvani parashe akasha — the cries of "Hari" touch the sky

173Then at the auspicious moment the Lord mounted the palanquin —
the hearts of all rejoice;
all kinds of instruments sound, conches and dundubhis roar,
cries of "Hari!" touch the sky.

সম্মুখে নাটুয়া নাচে, যার যেবা গুণ আছে,
সব সেইক্ষণে পরকাশ ।
প্রভু যায় চতুর্দোলে, জয় জয় লোকে বোলে,
উত্তরিলা আপন আবাস ॥ ১৭৪ ॥

sammukhe nāṭuẏā nāce, yāra yebā guṇa āche,
saba seikṣaṇe parakāśa |
prabhu yāẏa caturdole, jaẏa jaẏa loke bole,
uttarilā āpana ābāsa || 174 ||

sammukhe natuya nache — in front dancers dance; yara yeba guna achhe — whatever skill anyone has; saba sei-kshane parakasha — all display it at once; prabhu yaya chaturdole — the Lord rides in the palanquin; jaya jaya loke bole — people cry "Jaya, jaya!"; uttarila apana avasa — He arrived at His own home

174In front dancers dance; whatever skill anyone has,
all display it at once;
the Lord rides in the palanquin, people cry "Jaya, jaya!" —
and He arrived at His own home.

শচী উলসিত হঞা, নির্মঞ্ছন-সজ্জ লঞা,
আইহগণ সংহতি করিয়া ।
জয় জয় মঙ্গল পড়ে, সর্বলোক হরি বোলে,
নানাদ্রব্য ফেলায় নিছিয়া ॥ ১৭৫ ॥

śacī ulasita hañā, nirmañchana-sajja lañā,
āihagaṇa saṃhati kariẏā |
jaẏa jaẏa maṅgala paṛe, sarbaloka hari bole,
nānādrabya phelāẏa nichiẏā || 175 ||

shachi ulasita hana — Shachi, rejoicing; nirmanchhana-sajja lana — taking all for the nirmanchhana; aiha-gana samhati kariya — together with the married women; jaya jaya mangala pade — auspicious cries of "Jaya, jaya!" ring out; sarvaloka hari bole — all repeat "Hari"; nanadravya phelaya nichhiya — circling with all kinds of gifts, casts them away

175Shachi, rejoicing, taking all that was needed for the nirmanchhana,
together with the married women —
amid auspicious cries of "Jaya, jaya!", while all repeat "Hari!" —
circles [the couple] with all kinds of gifts and casts them away19.

সম্মুখে মঙ্গলঘট, কায়বার পড়ে ভাট,
বেদধ্বনি করয়ে ব্রাহ্মণে ।
বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়ার কর ধরি, বিশ্বম্ভর গৌরহরি,
গৃহে প্রবেশয়ে শুভক্ষণে ॥ ১৭৬ ॥

sammukhe maṅgalaghaṭa, kāẏabāra paṛe bhāṭa,
bedadhbani karaẏe brāhmaṇe |
biṣṇupriẏāra kara dhari, biśbambhara gaurahari,
gṛhe prabeśaẏe śubhakṣaṇe || 176 ||

sammukhe mangala-ghata — in front the auspicious pot; kayabara pade bhata — the bhats recite praises; veda-dhvani karaye brahmane — the brahmanas chant the Vedas; vishnupriyara kara dhari — holding Vishnupriya's hand; vishvambhara gaurahari — Vishvambhara Gaurahari; grihe praveshaye shubha-kshane — enters the house at the auspicious moment

176In front is the auspicious pot, the bhat bards sing praises,
the brahmanas chant the Vedas;
holding Vishnupriya by the hand, Vishvambhara Gaurahari
enters the house at the auspicious moment.

প্রেমানন্দে গরগর, কোলে করি বিশ্বম্ভর,
চুম্ব দেই সে চাঁদ-বদনে ।
আনন্দে বিভোল হঞা, আইহগণ-মাঝে গিয়া,
বধূ-কোলে শচীর নাচনে ॥ ১৭৭ ॥

premānande garagara, kole kari biśbambhara,
cumba dei se cāṁda-badane |
ānande bibhola hañā, āihagaṇa-mājhe giẏā,
badhū-kole śacīra nācane || 177 ||

prema-anande garagara — overwhelmed with love and joy; kole kari vishvambhara — embracing Vishvambhara; chumba dei se chanda-vadane — kisses [His] moon-like face; anande vibhola hana — beside herself with joy; aiha-gana-majhe giya — going among the married women; vadhu-kole shachira nachane — Shachi dances with her daughter-in-law in her arms

177Overwhelmed with love and joy, embracing Vishvambhara,
[Shachi] kisses His moon-like face;
beside herself with joy, she goes among the married women
and dances, holding her daughter-in-law in her arms.

আপনা না ধরে সুখে, নানাদ্রব্য দেই লোকে,
তুষ্ট হৈলা যত সর্বজন ।
বিশ্বম্ভর বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া, এক-মেলি দেখিয়া,
গোরাগুণ কহয়ে লোচন ॥ ১৭৮ ॥

āpanā nā dhare sukhe, nānādrabya dei loke,
tuṣṭa hailā yata sarbajana |
biśbambhara biṣṇupriẏā, eka-meli dekhiẏā,
gorāguṇa kahaẏe locana || 178 ||

apana na dhare sukhe — unable to contain herself for happiness; nanadravya dei loke — gives people all kinds of gifts; tushta haila yata sarvajana — everyone was satisfied; vishvambhara vishnupriya — Vishvambhara and Vishnupriya; eka-meli dekhiya — seeing together; gora-guna kahaye lochana — Lochana tells Gora's glories

178Forgetting herself in happiness, she gives people all kinds of gifts,
and everyone was satisfied.
Seeing Vishvambhara and Vishnupriya together,
Lochana sings the glories of Gora20.

Thus ends the description of the second wedding.

✦

Notes

  1. Lagna — the ascendant sign of the zodiac at the moment of the rite; tithi — the lunar day; nakshatra — the lunar asterism. Cf. Murari 1.14.3.
  2. In the 1983 edition the second line is different: "towards the end of the night the wives went to fetch water" (cf. en/18, note 1); we follow A.
  3. Vv. 95+1 – 95+4 (the fetching of water) are found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition gives them in a note as the additional reading of a manuscript and a printed edition.
  4. Vv. 98+1 – 98+5 are found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition has them, without brackets. Lochana Dasa's motif of nagari-bhava (see en/09, note 9; cf. en/18, vv. 40+1 – 40+9).
  5. Lochana Dasa's motif of nagari-bhava (see en/09, note 9).
  6. Vv. 105+1 – 105+2 are found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition has them.
  7. A traditional comparison of Bengali poetry: the graceful curve of the ear is likened to the ear of a vulture (gridhini).
  8. On the bheur, kahal, shinga, bargo, muhari and the others see en/18, note 11, and the glossary. The meaning of the word "dandima" (so in A and B) is unclear.
  9. Vv. 135–145 (and 142+1) — again Lochana Dasa's motif of nagari-bhava (see en/09, note 9; en/18, note 5).
  10. Stanza 142+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition has it, without brackets.
  11. A has "বরাড়ি রাগ — ধূলাখেলা-জাত"; probably an indication of the tune to which the song is sung (so also in the 1983 and 1903 editions).
  12. This stanza is absent in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives it in a note as an additional reading of the printed edition. The bride's mother, seeing the bridegroom, rejoices that her daughter is a worthy match for Him and restrains her excitement.
  13. The white garland on the Lord's golden body is like the Ganga running down the golden mountain Sumeru in two streams; cf. Murari 1.14.22–23 and en/19, v. 100.
  14. So Lochana Dasa names Vishnupriya; cf. v. 162, where the married women recognize in Vishnupriya Lakshmi and in Vishvambhara Vishnu. In the Gaudiya Vaishnava understanding Vishnupriya is the Lord's Bhu-shakti, Lakshmipriya His Shri-shakti (see en/21, note 9).
  15. On the word "chhamuni" see en/19, note 5.
  16. Vv. 161–165 are the scene in the bridal chamber (basara, see en/19, note 11), where by custom the women joke with the bridegroom; in Lochana Dasa it is again the motif of nagari-bhava (see en/09, note 9).
  17. Stanza 164+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition has it. "Kama" (desire) is the word by which the scriptures speak also of the gopis' love; the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Adi 4.164–171) explains that such "kama" is pure prema, the desire to please Krishna, not oneself. Lochana Dasa transfers these images to the women of Nadia (nagari-bhava; see en/09, note 9).
  18. Kushandika — the rite at the sacred fire that concludes the wedding (see en/18, note 2).
  19. Nichhani — auspicious objects are circled around the couple and cast away, warding off all that is inauspicious; cf. the nirmanchhana (en/19, note 17).
  20. Cf. Murari 1.14.26–33. In A the last two numbers are printed as "১৭০" and "১৭৬"; 177 and 178 are restored.
